business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

claimed_incidents.description: Tickets the customer listed in the claim.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

credit_cap_usd.description: Cap on credits for one escalation per billing period (cap percentage of the monthly fee).

credit_per_incident_usd.description: Credit per supported breached incident (credit percentage of the monthly fee).

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: expired-promotional and other-escalation credits on the ledger

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

monthly_fee_usd.description: Monthly fee on the active agreement that the credit schedule is applied to.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the Halcyon SLA credit claim.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: USD.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented credit cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing issue_net_entitlement_standard_run, issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle, pay_gross_claim_off_cycle.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: USD of SLA credit entitlement for the supported resolution-time breaches under SLA-ENT-2026 and AGR-7816

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

supported_incidents.description: Claimed tickets that are in scope, not duplicates, unexempt, and measured over the SLA target.

supported_quantity.description: credits on the AGR-7816 ledger that offset ESC-3171

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

unsupported_claim_usd.description: Portion of the claim the policy does not support (claimed amount minus entitlement).

decision_model.binding_constraint: the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule; expired-promotional and other-escalation credits on the ledger = 2300 USD; uncovered scope = 2700 USD

calculations.description: Preserved 2026-04-24 as the documented control date for the Halcyon SLA credit claim; did not infer urgency from a title or a request tone.
Established 3600 USD for USD of SLA credit entitlement for the supported resolution-time breaches under SLA-ENT-2026 and AGR-7816.
Correlated the independent source records to 3200 observed USD.
Removed 2300 USD for expired-promotional and other-escalation credits on the ledger.
Calculated 3200 observed − 2300 excluded = 900 supported USD.

Bound the state change to exactly 2700 USD, the measure required by the chosen disposition under the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule; did not substitute the header or another business quantity.
Kept the order, transfer, or dispense quantity in USD.
Derived 2026-05-04 for issue_net_entitlement_standard_run.
Derived 2026-04-23 for issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle.
Derived 2026-04-23 for pay_gross_claim_off_cycle and recognized its control impact.
Read 2026-05-04 as the independently confirmed standard readiness date for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.
Read 2026-04-23 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.
Counted the 5 tickets in the 2026-04-07 claim letter and the escalation record.

Tested each ticket on its own resolution clock: TCK-88510 (11.5 h vs 8 h) and TCK-88519 (43 h vs 24 h) breached; TCK-88514 resolved in 6.5 h, TCK-88523 is exempt inside the declared maintenance window, and TCK-88527 is a duplicate.
Read USD 18,000 from AGR-7816.
Applied 10% of USD 18,000 = USD 1,800 per supported breach.
Applied the 25% cap: USD 4,500 per escalation and billing period.
Preserved the customer's gross claim of USD 9,000 (five incidents at USD 1,800).
Calculated USD 9,000 claimed − USD 3,600 entitled = USD 5,400 unsupported.
Applied USD 2820 as the documented credit cost for issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that pay_gross_claim_off_cycle remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, cost, control status, and consequence of issue_net_entitlement_standard_run, issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle, pay_gross_claim_off_cycle; selected issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule.
Calculated 2026-04-23 as the supported outcome date for issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle.
Compared 2026-04-23 with the independent control date 2026-04-24 and calculated a signed variance of -1 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.

facts.rubric: Located ESC-3171 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: customer CUST-2292 (Halcyon Maritime) resolves to open claim escalation ESC-3171 on ticket TCK-88510; ESC-3120 is the closed February escalation with its own credit.
facts.statement: WORK-0008: customer CUST-2292 (Halcyon Maritime) resolves to open claim escalation ESC-3171 on ticket TCK-88510; ESC-3120 is the closed February escalation with its own credit; the effective revision is v1.

facts.rubric: Applied the escalation record and the v5 standard to establish 3600 USD for USD of SLA credit entitlement for the supported resolution-time breaches under SLA-ENT-2026 and AGR-7816, with control date 2026-04-24.
facts.statement: The effective escalation record and the v5 standard establish USD of SLA credit entitlement for the supported resolution-time breaches under SLA-ENT-2026 and AGR-7816 = 3600 USD: two of the five claimed tickets breached SLA-ENT-2026 resolution targets on their own clocks (TCK-88510 at 11.5 h against 8 h, TCK-88519 at 43 h against 24 h), so the entitlement is 2 × USD 1,800 = USD 3,600 under the USD 4,500 cap. The control date is 2026-04-24 (clause 9.6 makes the 2026-04-24 renewal invoice final once issued, so the credit must be reflected on or before it (CMT-4498)).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 3200 observed less 2300 excluded to 900 supported USD for credits on the AGR-7816 ledger that offset ESC-3171.
facts.statement: the gross ledger holds USD 3,200; CR-9255 (1,800) belongs to ESC-3120 and CR-9281 (500) is an expired promotion, so only CR-9270 (900) offsets and USD 2,700 remains owed; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-04 standard and 2026-04-23 expedited readiness inputs from the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates, then separately derived each alternative's operating outcome under the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule instead of treating a counterparty promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates: the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 gives an off-cycle note applied 2026-04-22 (reflected 2026-04-23, +USD 120) and the 2026-05-01 invoice run (reflected 2026-05-04); a counterparty confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied the billing-run calendar and its credit-memo cut-off against the renewal invoice to derive the three option outcomes without displacing protected blocks or committed dates.
facts.statement: the billing-run calendar and its credit-memo cut-off against the renewal invoice: the billing-run calendar's May run is 2026-05-01 with a 2026-04-24 cut-off, after the renewal invoice; only the off-cycle note lands before 2026-04-24; protected and leave blocks cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-WP-0108 only to issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle and ESC-3171; kept pay_gross_claim_off_cycle outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-WP-0108 covers one SLA-resolution credit memo up to USD 5,000 on either billing route with the USD 120 recharge allowed; the gross claim and anything above the cap need the finance controller, and the maintenance-window ticket needs a support-director exception. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize pay_gross_claim_off_cycle.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule.
facts.statement: clause 9.6 makes the 2026-04-24 renewal invoice final, so a credit reflected after it cannot be netted; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule.

options.consequence: issue net entitlement standard run submits the same USD 2,700 on the 2026-05-01 invoice run, reflected 2026-05-04, ten days after the renewal invoice that cannot be re-issued; it saves the USD 120 recharge but fails the control date.
options.label: issue_net_entitlement_standard_run: outcome 2026-05-04, incremental cost USD 2700, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: issue net entitlement off cycle submits the USD 2,700 net entitlement (3,600 for two supported breaches less the 900 goodwill already issued) as an off-cycle credit note applied 2026-04-22, reflected 2026-04-23, one day before the renewal invoice, for USD 120 inside AP-WP-0108.
options.label: issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle: outcome 2026-04-23, incremental cost USD 2820, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: pay gross claim off cycle would credit the customer's full USD 9,000 claim less the 900 already issued (USD 8,100 plus the 120 recharge) on 2026-04-23, but it exceeds the USD 4,500 agreement cap and the account director's limit and needs the finance controller.
options.label: pay_gross_claim_off_cycle: outcome 2026-04-23, incremental cost USD 8220, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

decision_model.recommendation_reason: issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the SLA credit schedule, the agreement cap, the maintenance-window exemption, and the ledger offset rule and lands 1 day(s) on or before the control date.

instruction: Halcyon are claiming resolution-time credits for the early-April scheduling outage, five tickets in all, and their renewal invoice goes out on the twenty-fourth and cannot be re-issued. Check each ticket's resolution clock against the Enterprise policy, set aside the duplicate and the one raised inside their own maintenance window, net off what the ledger already carries for this escalation, and tell me how much we still owe. Raise the credit on the route that lands before the renewal invoice within Folake's approval, and draft the note for Bryn. The gross figure and any exception for the maintenance-window ticket belong to Mats and Desmond, not to us.

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
